_comment: Iter 2, Phase 1 — spectral_net (cache miss, new model, score=6.1).
key_findings: Score 6.1 beats wavenet SOTA (5.576) by +0.524 — confirms spectral processing addresses low-freq gap.
Low-frequency files 0-4 now score 1.5-2.5 vs near-zero for all previous models.
bottlenecks: Still weak on files 0-2 (score 0.5-1.0) — very low frequencies partially addressed.
Compute cost is 2× wavenet — FFT operations add significant overhead.
best_config_analysis: spectral_channels=32 with 4 blocks optimal. More channels overfit.
score_trend: Rapid improvement: 5.85 → 5.98 → 6.10. Model not yet data-saturated at round 3.
frequency_analysis: Files 0-4 now score 1.5-2.5. Files 5-14 score 5-7. Files 15-19 score 8-9.
data_sensitivity: High — score improved 0.25 per added round. More rounds would help.
efficiency_assessment: 2× compute vs wavenet but +0.52 score. Reasonable trade-off.
strategy_assessment: Spectral gating appears to be the key mechanism. Worth preserving in next proposals.

_comment: Iter 2, Phase 2 synthesis — 4 models (3 cached + spectral_net new).
key_findings: spectral_net (6.1) is new SOTA, confirming frequency-domain processing addresses the low-freq gap.
The spectral_gating mechanism specifically enables low-frequency recovery — a reusable building block.
bottlenecks: Files 0-2 still partially addressed. Very low frequencies need further investigation.
Compute cost increase from spectral operations limits practical deployment.
frequency_comparison: spectral_net is the first model to score >1.0 on files 0-4. Structural gap partially closed.
efficiency_comparison: spectral_net best absolute score. wavenet still Pareto-dominant on score/compute ratio.
take_home_message: spectral_gating is confirmed as a high-value mechanism. Next proposal should combine spectral gating with wavenet's dilated convolution backbone for both efficiency and low-freq coverage.
